title: Bad Trips Guide, Round 23
intro: Round 23 (2026-11-07). Your two versions from round 22 are in. Your denial move made six more paragraphs read Human. Your After the Storm moves didn't carry in my hands: 0 of 12 tries read Human, though I used a question to the reader, the why, "(or false)"-style nuance, "an" for "one", and the list said in a voice's own words. So here are the next two paragraphs to teach me from. They're the kinds most of the stuck instructions share: a long list of don'ts, and a numbered list of steps. A fresh reader read each one for sense first, and the cards say what it found.
Everything that tested well and kept the meaning went into the guide without a card; my message lists it.

suggestions.title: No Rash Actions: a long list of don'ts
suggestions.reading: As the guide has it, with the action lock before it, each read after the Human first half of Psychological First Aid and the section's heading: [AI, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/173cdc51-97bf-4765-ba5a-87b141a65ca8).
suggestions.tested:
1. "What really can't wait until you've slept and eaten? Usually nothing, so don't drive, travel, break up, ..." [AI, 100%](https://www.pangram.com/history/f59db310-a21b-42a9-9964-8c6cc58f9439). This try puts a question to the reader first and keeps the list.

2. The lock said as talk ("Give it 24–72 hours before you act on anything."), with the list after it: [73%](https://www.pangram.com/history/424017ee-a823-4d47-bff5-fa5903d0f8c0).
suggestions.sense: "Send the message" and "post the revelation" don't say which message, or post where. The 24–72 hour lock just above it and this list's "until you have slept and eaten" give two different ends. Driving and travel have no emergency exception (getting to a hospital). "Confront" and "accuse" overlap. The list never says why (judgment is off, and none of these can be undone), and what to do instead is the next line ("Write it down, get some sleep, and go back over it sober with one grounded person"). My tries above didn't fix any of these. "Make a grand purchase" is the item you approved in round 21.
suggestions.why: Fifteen don'ts in one sentence, and it reads AI in every wording I've tried. The same shape is in After the Storm's "another ceremony" list, Shadow Thoughts' during-a-trip paragraph, the helper's don'ts, the harm part's lines, and Abuse Memories' "Don't confront tonight".
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: say it the way you'd tell someone at 3 a.m. Keep every item, or tell me which can go. I'll carry what you do to the paragraphs above, test each, and put the ones that read Human straight in.

suggestions.title: Minimum Viable Integration: a numbered list of steps
suggestions.reading: As the guide has it, each read after the Human first half of Psychological First Aid and the section's heading: [66%](https://www.pangram.com/history/4b8c71dd-d48b-40bf-81e8-e1b89c15b779).
suggestions.tested:
1. The why put inside two steps ("write down the facts while you still remember them"; "think about what the experience may have meant ... (it may mean less than it felt like, or more)"): [75%](https://www.pangram.com/history/0ce22da5-c317-48aa-8f72-095be4450e94).

2. The third step said as talk: [73%](https://www.pangram.com/history/6dfd0d19-13a4-4600-a727-1977d8f3104e).
suggestions.sense: The heading's "Minimum Viable Integration" is startup jargon, and "integration" isn't explained anywhere before it. "Ordinary contact", "no big moves", "behavioral changes" and "increase love" are vague, and "no big moves" repeats No Rash Actions' lock. "Then" and "Last" give no timing. The list never says why facts come before meaning (so the story doesn't rewrite what happened), or why to write down the substance and dose (to be safer next time). My first try covered only some of these.
suggestions.why: Four labeled steps, and it reads AI in every wording I've tried. The same shape is in Give the Session a Beginning and an End's list, What Kind of Aftermath Is This?, the distortions list in Why Bad Trips Tend to Happen, the loop breaker, and Who to Contact's directories.
suggestions.advice_note: Edit it: keep it a list or make it prose, whichever you'd write, and keep every step. I'll carry what you do to the lists above, test each, and put the ones that read Human straight in.
